params.prompt: A frame grabbed from a Korean sitcom video, 9:16 vertical: candid mid-action, caught between movements, slight natural motion softness on the hands, not a posed photo. Evening living room (warm lamps, string lights, arched window dark navy), fixed tripod camera at eye level, natural skin, no beauty filter, no text, no watermark. Keep the exact face, hair, glasses and clothes of the people in the reference images and the exact room and sofa. Medium shot: the woman (27, Filipino-American, warm golden-tan skin, long dark wavy hair with curtain bangs, white poplin shirt with cuffed sleeves, dark-indigo jeans, small gold hoops, no glasses) standing in front of the caramel sofa, both hands clasped in front of her, slightly bowing her head with a sweet bright smile toward the entrance (off-screen left), the sofa and window behind her.
